identical_pair_request_comparison.scope: Identical serialized direct-helper requests at temperature0 across two independently seeded runs; not a controlled isolated reproducibility experiment. No KV reuse found in source audit.

proposed_incremental_schedule.scope: Independent proposed scheduler simulation; not production implementation or C overflow proof.

editorial_boundary.conclusion: Pairs 2-38 are distinct events in one developing press-access dispute; 15-93 is one speech preview/outcome; 48-49 lacks evidence connecting separate events. Optional related-story references and strict event identity are different product contracts. This review does not turn either failed same-event evaluation into a pass.

limitations: No application preparation/persistence or native GPU proof for these experimental protocols.
Lookup co-presence is not a direct pair verdict. Every report was exposed but independent importance assessments were not rerun in these lookup-only experiments.
The 22 labeled pairs do not establish corpus-wide precision or recall. Uncertain labels remain separate from known negatives.
Both complete 108-report experiments grouped only eight of twelve labeled matches and merged one of seven labeled negatives.
Directions, evidence allocation and proposed-edge closure differ between the two runs; their timings are not an isolated benchmark.
Append-stable lookup needs 4144 windows for 500 reports; no fast full-library acceptance claim.
PR156 retains the original strict-partition implementation and remains draft; none of these experiments changed production policy.

bounded_reference_negative_control.scope: Experimental optional references for one fixed story, no application integration, ranking changes or full-edition readiness claim.
bounded_reference_negative_control.ranking: Original baseScore descending, stable story-ID tie; no new importance assessment.
bounded_reference_negative_control.label_selection: Highest base score among reports absent from prior independent pair labels; stable story-ID tie. Selected before this run.
bounded_reference_negative_control.positive_case_search: Independent source-only review found no identifiable same-event positive among remaining unlabeled references; no substitute positive case was run.
bounded_reference_negative_control.boundary: This passing negative control establishes no positive recall, whole-library latency, ranking correctness or production readiness; not adopted.

ranking_bound_review.group_score: max(member base) + max(member importance adjustment), adjustment = 3 * (importance - 3), range [-9, 6]
ranking_bound_review.bound: For descending-base anchors, U(i) = base(i) + maximum adjustment among i and later reports, no greater than base(i) + 6.
ranking_bound_review.safe_pruning_condition: U(i) strictly below a certified lower bound for the kth distinct final group; singleton kth score is not certified because future merges can collapse candidates. Equality must retain tie-breaking consideration.
ranking_bound_review.reference_constraint: Reports skipped as anchors must remain possible references and importance contributors to retained anchors.
ranking_bound_review.limit: Worst-case equal or close scores do not prune. This is a mathematical review, not an implemented or benchmarked scheduler.
